install.hint_title: Add Parking to your Home Screen
install.hint: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then open it from the icon.

alerts.intro: Get told how many spaces are free. A web app can't follow your location in the background, so notifications come from reminders you set, or while the app is open.
alerts.mock_note: Preview with sample data: notifications are shown by this device only.
alerts.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Try Chrome on Android, Safari on iPhone (iOS 16.4 or later, added to the Home Screen) or a desktop browser.
alerts.ios_install: On iPhone, notifications only work in the app added to your Home Screen.
alerts.denied_browser: To allow them: open this site's settings (the icon next to the address), set Notifications to Allow, then reload the page.
alerts.denied_app: In the installed app: open the phone's Settings → Apps (or Notifications) → Parking, and allow notifications.
alerts.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
alerts.turned_off: Notifications are off for this device.
alerts.near_hint: Only while the app is open.
alerts.near_denied: Location is blocked. Allow it in this site's settings (or the installed app's settings) to use this.
alerts.almost_full_hint: When a zone you follow is almost full or full.
alerts.reminders_hint: Get the free spaces at a set time.
alerts.quiet_hint: No reminders or warnings in this time.
alerts.test_sent: Sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.

error.dismissed: Notifications weren't allowed. Tap the button again to choose.
error.unavailable: Notifications aren't set up on the server yet.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a while and try again.
error.gone: This device isn't registered for notifications any more. Enable them again.
error.failed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
